title: Agent Capabilities
description: Understand what AI agents can do and how to configure them

steps.title: Agent Architecture
steps.description: Agents are LLM-powered workers that can use tools, access your notes, and execute multi-step tasks autonomously.

steps.title: Built-in Capabilities
steps.description: Note CRUD, search, property extraction, summarization, translation, code generation, web search, API calls

steps.title: Configure Agent
steps.description: Go to Settings → AI → Agent to set model, temperature, and enabled tools

steps.title: Skill System
steps.description: Agents gain capabilities through skills. Install skills from the registry or create custom ones.

steps.title: Test Agent
steps.description: Open Command Palette → 'Agent: Chat' and ask: 'Summarize my notes from last week'

steps.title: Privacy & Limits
steps.description: Agents run locally by default. Cloud models require opt-in. Set token budgets and rate limits in settings.
